name: Nang Tani
description: A female tree spirit of Thai (and Lao and Cambodian) folklore, believed to inhabit clumps of the wild banana Musa acuminata (kluai tani). She is one of the best-known Nang Mai (tree spirits) and is generally benevolent, though said to harm men who have wronged women.

aliases.name: Phi Tani
aliases.meaning: Ghost of Tani (ผีตานี)

aliases.name: Phrai Tani
aliases.meaning: Nymph of Tani (พรายตานี)

origin: Folklore of Nang Tani is concentrated in Thailand and extends to neighboring Laos and Cambodia.
